name: Covenant of Abaddon
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 219, Faiths of Corruption pg. 19
body:
Drawbacks
Covenant of Abaddon
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 219, Faiths of Corruption pg. 19
Category Religion
Requirement(s) any of the Four Horsemen
Because your soul is pledged to one of the Horsemen, you gain a +2 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against level-draining effects.
